edges: Art Berry and Fede are associates working together as double-agents.
Art Berry meets Linda after hitting her with his car.
Art Berry works as a consultant for the Greenwich 0 tribe.
Art Berry is a double-agent for the Eastern Standard Tribe.
Art Berry delivers subtly flawed proposals to the GMT tribe.
Art Berry attacks Fede after discovering his betrayal.
Art Berry is committed to an insane asylum.
Art Berry escapes from the asylum and founds a new company.
